frequency_question: How often do executive agency principals successfully execute formal withdrawal of recognition from a major legacy accreditor when pursuing such a policy?
membership_rule: Includes any formal administrative proceeding initiated by the U.S. Department of Education or its leadership to strip an established national or professional accrediting body of its recognition. Excludes minor compliance warnings, voluntary relinquishments, or renewals with conditions.
